selected_script.angle: Overcrowded bedroom closet accessory clutter causing daily frustration, solved instantly by hanging the 3-tier woven basket organizer over the closet door.
selected_script.hook: Handheld phone-shot POV of a hand digging through a messy, tangled pile of accessories and socks on a closet floor, accidentally knocking a basket of small items over.

usage_steps_used: Step 1: Hang the metal hook over the top of a door
Step 2: Suspend the woven basket assembly by slipping the top rope loop onto the hook
Step 3: Place items loosely inside the 3 woven basket tiers

script_record.0-3s: Handheld phone-shot POV of a messy bedroom floor where a stack of accessories and scarves is cluttered, and a hand accidentally knocks them into a tangled pile.
script_record.3-6s: A hand slides the silver metal hook over the top edge of a white wooden bedroom door, and slips the thick natural jute rope loop of the 3-tier woven basket assembly onto the hook, letting the tan braided rope baskets hang vertically.
script_record.6-10s: Placing folded scarves and accessories loosely inside the first basket tier. Clean, organized layout.
script_record.10-14s: Fast-cut to showing the second tier loaded with baby wipes and small daily items in a nursery door setup.
script_record.14-18s: Fast-cut to the third tier showing folded towels neatly organized in a clean bathroom door setting, showcasing its natural woven rope texture.
